note: Declared pairwise conflicts. Severity: info (advisory), warn (default-off recommendation), error (cannot both be enabled). The priority names the skill that should win when both match.

conflicts.reason: focus guards a single deep-work session while brainstorming deliberately opens divergent exploration; running both simultaneously dilutes both outcomes. Chaining (brainstorm first, then focus) is allowed.
unlazy forces a single smallest next action whereas brainstorming expands into many ideas; simultaneity conflicts, chaining does not.
